applicability: SMALL_PILOT_ONLY; frozen only when accompanied by freeze.json
rationale: Conservative engineering screens, examined on FIT SUCCESS and difficult FIT runs. No DEV threshold tuning; these are data selection rules, not a safety proof or optimal driving labels.
bc_a_policy: Whole SUCCESS episode only if every review window passes; no automatic acceptance from outcome.
bc_b_policy: BC-A plus approved TIMEOUT intervals; remove 5s around non-approved windows, last 10s, and intervals shorter than 5s.
uncertain_policy: Exclude from demonstrations, retain immutable raw evidence and reasons. No relabeling of unknown as unsafe or safe.
